seal.statement: The Phase 0.3 locking-read policy has one exact machine/prose transition contract: every transition's owner, action semantics and outcome are mirrored in its architecture row; contention and abort identifiers are canonical and identical to typedOutcomes; localExpiry, reservationPersistence and multiParticipantConflict are explicitly verified; and the design-only proof fails closed if its comparison base is unavailable.
